analysis.title: GS Novak - GS U.S. Industrials & Materials | after the Fed 28 Oct 2026
key_insights: Intraday on 10/28/26: industrials at session highs up 30bps, materials down 30bps, healthcare leading the broader tape and communications lagging. High beta momentum leads factors and short interest lags. By subsector, AI/data center leads, aerospace is reasonably strong and transports are down the most.

VRT +14% after Q3 results, which the desk calls underwhelming. The stock is down ~50% since its May analyst day, after an organic growth miss in the Americas in Q2. Organic growth reaccelerated from 20% in Q2 to +66% in Q3, with a beat/raise and orders up 100%. The desk sees possible follow-through from the reset, higher estimates and continued orders strength, but remains cautious on AI/data center including VRT.
Other AI/data center names showed caution in the trade: APH +2% on a clean beat and raise, GEV down on implied Q4 weakness and 11 GW at the low end of expectations, TEL down 1%.

ODFL -6% despite higher estimates after a Q3 beat and Q4 commentary (revenue guided above consensus, margins in line, so EBIT higher). The desk says the KPI is volumes, which are catching up, and October underperformed seasonality. The revenue boost is fuel, which the market looks through. The stock also broke below its 50-day.
CHRW -11% after a surprisingly light Q3 driven by lower margins. The desk says the narrative has fully shifted.

Airbus (AIR FP), per GIR: confirms c.870 deliveries guidance with the FY26 outlook unchanged. Q3 adjusted EBIT of €1,768mn was c.1% below consensus, on revenue of €17.47bn, c.2% below. FCF before customer financing was -€102mn vs company-compiled consensus of +€325mn, attributed to inventory build for back-end-loaded deliveries. GIR expects investors to focus on year-end cash conversion, supply-chain health and delivery target confidence.

Price action is following results quality and positioning: clean beats/raises with no overhangs are seeing follow-through, while names with overhangs see downside follow-through, and some positioning moves are reversing.
After the close on 10/28: AMRZ CVNA FDX HONA ORLY STRL in focus. Pre-market 10/29 key names: ATI CARR CAT CRH EME HWM LHX LIN PWR TT VMC XPO.
